client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: The Client ID of your Kwai Marketing API app.

client_secret.title: Client Secret
client_secret.description: The Client Secret of your Kwai Marketing API app.

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: The refresh token obtained from Kwai's OAuth flow, used to generate new access tokens.

agent_id.title: Agent ID
agent_id.description: The Kwai Business Center agency (agent) ID that owns the advertiser accounts to sync. Only used to list accounts for the 'advertisers' stream and only if Account IDs is empty -- if you already know your account IDs, set those instead and leave this blank. Some app registrations (e.g. 'channel developer' apps) are rejected outright when using Agent ID to list accounts, no matter its value.

corp_id.title: Corp ID
corp_id.description: Alternative to Agent ID for listing accounts. Takes precedence over Agent ID when both are set. Same caveats as Agent ID apply -- prefer Account IDs if you already know them.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: The earliest date to pull report data from, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: The latest date to pull report data from, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty to sync up to today.

account_ids.title: Account IDs
account_ids.description: The advertiser account IDs to sync. Recommended: when set, campaigns/ad_groups/ads/ads_reports_daily query these accounts directly and never call the account-listing endpoint, avoiding a permission error some app registrations hit there. Leave empty only if your app can list accounts via Agent ID or Corp ID.

time_zone.title: Time Zone
time_zone.description: The IANA-style time zone offset Kwai should report metrics in (e.g. UTC-3). Accepted values are limited by Kwai's API.

lookback_window_days.title: Lookback Window (days)
lookback_window_days.description: Number of days before the last synced date to re-fetch on every incremental run, to capture late conversion updates.

window_in_days.title: Window Size (days)
window_in_days.description: Maximum number of days requested in a single report call.

page_size.title: Page Size
page_size.description: Number of records requested per page from the Kwai API.
